summary: Path parsing, normalisation, and scheme-aware dispatch. StoragePath (identify_scheme, normalize, join, matches), SchemeSpec registry (30+ schemes incl. placeholders), S3-specific helpers (s3_bucket, s3_key), suffix-aware transform inference (infer_pipeline from .gz/.gpg chains).
extension_points: SCHEMES registry: add SchemeSpec entries for new URL schemes
SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS dict: add suffix-to-transform mappings for new compression/encryption formats
lifecycle_notes: Phase 3 (#40): hygiene pass, extracted scheme.py and storage_path.py
Phase 5 (#41): canonical dispatcher — StoragePath.identify_scheme and SCHEMES registry
Phase 6 (#42): suffix-aware inference — infer_pipeline and SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS

open_questions.question: Placeholder schemes (dbfs, hdfs, spark, gdrive, etc.) are defined but have no backend — should they be documented or hidden?
open_questions.evidence: scheme.py lists ~15 placeholder SchemeSpec entries with no corresponding backend
